_comment: Descriptive company facts for the dashboard Company Profiles. Keyed by the consolidated deal name (lowercased). Each entry's 'source' labels where website/description/sector/hq came from. Domicile is intentionally NOT set here - it is sourced from the legal documents (grounded) per the sourcing rule. External/web facts are candidates pending analyst confirmation.

neuralink.description: American neurotechnology company developing implantable brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) to link the human brain with computers.

cerebras systems inc.description: AI compute company that builds the world's largest processors (Wafer-Scale Engine) and CS-series supercomputers, plus AI inference and training cloud services.

ont plc.description: UK genomics company that develops nanopore-based sequencing technology for real-time analysis of DNA and RNA (MinION, GridION, PromethION); listed on the London Stock Exchange.

drivenets.description: Israeli networking-software company providing a disaggregated, cloud-native network operating system on white-box hardware and an Ethernet-based AI networking fabric.

instadeep limited.description: AI company specialising in decision-making AI for the enterprise; London-based, a subsidiary of BioNTech.
